Sneha Joshi
Backend Engineer | Cochin
sneha.joshi612@example.com | +91 9403688609

Results-oriented backend engineer with strong focus on cloud-native services and scalable systems. Experienced in designing and shipping microservices in Go, optimizing service reliability on AWS, and improving deployment velocity through containerization and CI/CD. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 60 days.

Experience
Zoho — Dec 2024 - Present
Go Developer, Remote
- Implemented gRPC-based microservice endpoints in Go to replace legacy REST calls, improving inter-service latency by 35% and reducing request CPU usage by 22% (observed in CloudWatch).
- Containerized services with Docker and authored Kubernetes manifests and Helm charts to enable zero-downtime rollouts across three clusters, cutting deployment time from 45 minutes to under 10 minutes.
- Led migration of background workers to AWS Lambda + S3-triggered pipelines for batch processing, lowering operational cost for nightly jobs by 40% while maintaining throughput.
- Automated service monitoring and alerting using CloudWatch metrics and custom dashboards; reduced mean-time-to-detect by 50% and automated recovery for common pod restarts via Kubernetes probes.

Projects
Service Mesh PoC
- Built a proof-of-concept integrating gRPC services with sidecar proxies on a Kubernetes test cluster to evaluate traffic shaping and observability; documented configuration and produced performance comparison charts.

ETL Lambda Pipeline
- Designed a serverless ETL pipeline using Lambda functions triggered by S3 events to validate and transform incoming data into PostgreSQL; included retry logic and CloudWatch-based alerting.

Skills
Languages: Go, gRPC
Stack: Microservices, PostgreSQL, Docker
Cloud & Infra: Kubernetes, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch
Process & Tools: Agile, Git

Education
B.Tech, Computer Engineering, MPSTME NMIMS
